# --- [CELL 4]: ---

class CustomModelMultichoice(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,config,num_choice):
        super(CustomModelMultichoice,self).__init__()
        model = AutoModelForMultipleChoice.from_config(config)
        model.classifier = nn.Linear(768,2)
        self.model = model

        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()
        self.num_choice = num_choice
    def forward(self,input_ids = None,token_type_ids = None ,attention_mask = None,labels = None):
        outputs = self.model(input_ids=input_ids,token_type_ids=token_type_ids,attention_mask=attention_mask)
        logits = self.sigmoid(outputs.logits)
        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss_func = nn.NLLLoss()
            loss = loss_func(logits.view(-1,self.num_choice),labels.view(-1))
        return MultipleChoiceModelOutput(loss = loss,logits=logits,hidden_states= None,attentions =None)

# --- [CELL 6]: ---

prompt = "Bác Hồ là người nước nào ?."
candidate1 = "Việt Nam"
candidate2 = "Mỹ"
candidate3 = 'Việt Nam'

class CustomModelMultichoice(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,config,num_choice):
        super(CustomModelMultichoice,self).__init__()
        model = AutoModelForMultipleChoice.from_config(config)
        model.classifier = nn.Linear(768,num_choice)
        self.model = model

        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()
        self.num_choice = num_choice
    def forward(self,input_ids = None,token_type_ids = None ,attention_mask = None,labels = None):
        outputs = self.model(input_ids=input_ids,token_type_ids=token_type_ids,attention_mask=attention_mask)
        logits = self.sigmoid(outputs.logits)
        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss_func = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
            # Reshape logits from (batch_size * num_choices, num_choice) to (batch_size, num_choice, num_choice)
            # then select the appropriate dimension to match labels shape (batch_size, num_choice)
            batch_size = labels.size(0)
            reshaped_logits = outputs.logits.view(batch_size, self.num_choice, self.num_choice)
            # Take the mean across the second dimension (reduce from 3 choices to match labels)
            logits_for_loss = reshaped_logits.mean(dim=1)
            loss = loss_func(logits_for_loss.view(-1, self.num_choice), labels.float().view(-1, self.num_choice))
        return MultipleChoiceModelOutput(loss = loss,logits=logits,hidden_states = None,attentions =None)
